name: Visual Pack
description: Every visual enhancement in one pack. Each effect is its own render pipeline with its own OPTIONS row and on/off ladder, and they stack: DAY/NIGHT lighting (time-aware), CRT lines, vignette, letterbox, weather (rain/snow/fog), ambient motes, RGB split, film grain, night stars, color grade, and duotone (GB green / sepia / noir). Safe overlay/color techniques with shader fallbacks; no engine files edited.
